name: Supabase Plugin for AI Coding Agents
Claude Code plugin CLI JSON output (2.1.268)
claude plugin validate — MCP server checks (Claude Code 2.1.281)
Claude Haiku 5.5
what: New cheapest, fastest Anthropic small model, now default Haiku on the API with 1M context.
pitch: WPR's 40+ scrapers burn tokens turning HTML and agendas into JSON. A 1M-context model at ten cents per million input tokens makes nightly extraction crons effectively free.
access: paid · $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K) · model id claude-haiku-5-5

name: Claude Code mods (plugin authoring APIs, 2.1.292–2.1.294)
what: TypeScript code shipped in plugins that rewrites Claude Code behavior, tools, prompts and UI.
pitch: A solo dev policing 40 repos can encode guardrails as executable code instead of repeating CLAUDE.md rules. This week added prompt caching, prompt.autocomplete hooks, deferred tool schemas, and mod test mocks.
access: free · built into Claude Code 2.1.292+ · ship as a plugin, validate with claude plugin validate

name: claude plugin install --marketplace
what: New flag that adds a plugin marketplace if needed and installs from it in one command.
pitch: Rowan reinstalls the same skill set on every new machine and CI image. One command now replaces marketplace add plus install, under the same policy checks.
access: free · Claude Code 2.1.292+ · claude plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>

name: Claude Code WebFetch truncation fix (2.1.290)
what: WebFetch no longer silently drops page text past 100,000 characters; it reports and accepts offset.
pitch: WPR fetches very long agendas, dockets and meeting minutes. Silent truncation meant records quietly vanished from any long page Claude read, with no error to catch in review.
access: free · update Claude Code to 2.1.290 or later

name: Scrapfly Cloud Browser Credential Vault (beta)
what: End-to-end encrypted vault holding passwords, passkeys, TOTP seeds and cookies for stealth cloud browser sessions.
pitch: Login-gated portals are the hardest part of WPR scraping. Credentials stay out of repo CI secrets, and logins run through real Chromium autofill and WebAuthn paths, so sessions look human.
access: paid · Scrapfly account, vault beta open to all accounts · skills via npx skills add scrapfly/skills

name: mattpocock/skills (Skills For Real Engineers)
what: Small, composable engineering skills for spec-writing, ticket breakdown, TDD, debugging and architecture review.
pitch: The week's fastest-rising skill pack, and it targets exactly the solo-dev failure mode: agent builds the wrong thing across 40 repos with no spec and no tests.

name: Ponytail 5
what: Single skill that makes the agent write only necessary code without cutting validation, security or tests.
pitch: Ground-up v5 released this month, trending hard. Benchmarked on a FastAPI + React repo: 53% less code, 45% fewer tokens, and risky logic shipped with tests 98% of the time.
access: open-source (MIT) · install from the repo as a Claude Code plugin (see INSTALL.md)

name: Anatomy
what: Agent skill generating interactive isometric SVG/WebGL figures that explain a concept as a working machine.
pitch: Mid-October launch that went viral; ships standalone HTML, a lone SVG, or React/Next components — drop-in output for WPR's embeddable widget fleet, with zero dependencies.
access: open-source (MIT) · npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g -a claude-code (installs to ~/.claude/skills/anatomy)

name: Claude Code /auto-mode-setup
what: Guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode your environment.
pitch: Added in 2.1.304 and now available on gateways and telemetry-disabled sessions. For unattended work across a 40-repo fleet, it cuts the permission prompts that stall long agent runs.
access: free with Claude Code (included in paid Claude plans) · run /auto-mode-setup

name: Claude Duet (research preview)
what: Proactive Claude agent app that monitors connected apps and sends a daily brief of what needs attention.
pitch: Opened October 21 for US Pro/Max. Built on Opus 5.5, it watches inboxes and calendars and only pings when something matters — a triage layer for a one-person newsroom tech shop.
access: waitlist · included in Pro and Max plans, US only, shares existing usage limits

name: top-claude-code-skills (Selan daily ranking)
what: Daily-regenerated GitHub ranking of Claude Code skills by stars, weekly momentum and monthly activity.
pitch: Useful plumbing for this radar: it excludes forks, dead repos, star farms and anything shipping no SKILL.md, so weekly movers are pre-filtered rather than listicle noise.
access: free · CC0 repo, README regenerated daily (no install needed)

name: Claude Code skill-loading and skill-library fixes (2.1.312–2.1.314)
what: Directory-scoped and paths: skills load again after a Bash cd; skills/.trash no longer grows unbounded.
pitch: Repo-scoped skills silently vanished once Claude cd'd into a subdirectory — exactly what a 40-repo fleet does all day. The trash cap also ends the file-watcher load that grows with every skill you uninstall.
access: free · upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.314 or later

name: Agent Skills donated to the Agentic AI Foundation
what: Anthropic handed the SKILL.md standard, its GitHub org and agentskills.io to the Linux Foundation's AAIF.
pitch: Announced Oct 22. The proposed roadmap is versioned spec releases, a formal proposal process, and security guidance for people who write and install skills — the missing piece when you install community skills unreviewed.
access: free · open standard, spec at agentskills.io

name: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT (Claude Code 2.1.316)
what: Environment variable setting the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one.
pitch: Subagent fan-out is how a solo dev audits 40 repos at once, but inheriting the session's effort makes grunt work expensive. This decouples the two without dropping the main session's quality.

name: permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories (Claude Code 2.1.314)
what: Setting that makes Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode.
pitch: Running unattended sessions over a 40-repo fleet means one bad path can edit the wrong scraper. This confines writes regardless of permission mode, pairing with the existing read-side setting.

name: Large CLAUDE.md overwrite protection (Claude Code 2.1.312)
what: Write now makes Claude read a large CLAUDE.md or rules file in full, or edit in place.
pitch: Every WPR repo carries a long CLAUDE.md. Previously Claude could replace one in a subdirectory after seeing only its opening lines, quietly deleting scraper, Supabase and widget conventions.

name: Opus 4.8 fast mode deprecation, removal November 30 2026
what: Fast mode on Opus 4.8 was deprecated October 30 and errors after November 30, with no fallback.
pitch: This is a hard deadline, not a slowdown: scripts pinned to Opus 4.8 fast mode will return errors rather than silently falling back to standard Opus 4.8.
access: paid · included in Claude plans; migrate to Opus 5.5 before Nov 30
